svg.text: TYPICAL WELD SYMBOLS (AWS A2.4) - arrow side below reference line
Engine / genset pedestals to tender rails
Fillet sizes = leg (mm). ○ = weld all around. Tail = inspection. E70XX, prequalified WPS (D1.1 Cl. 5); preheat per Table 5.8 for A572-50 > 20 mm; grind toes on cyclic truck welds (cat. C→B').
L4.2: safety-chain lugs PL44.5 (1-3/4 in) A572-50 faced to 42.5 mm at the jaw, 1-1/8 in Crosby G-2130 shackles + S-1325A; CJP (TC-U4b) + PL16 diaphragm; UT 100 %; preheat Table 5.8.
45T split ring to hub flange (fitted DIN 609)
1. Running-gear and drive fasteners: re-torque after first 10 h running; witness-mark all.
2. Structural slip-critical joints (if any added): ASTM F3125 A325, RCSC 2020 turn-of-nut.
3. CWI inspection of primary members (drawgear, trucks, drive brackets). Welders qualified to D1.1 / D1.3.
4. Zinc-plated fasteners: use dry K 0.20 column; lubricated (MoS2) K 0.14 column only where specified.
5. L4.2 P-103-1 motor hanger: L-weld 140 + 150, 10 mm fillet both sides + 2 PL16 gussets (6 mm both sides, structural); MT 100 % (Loco Bot L-103 fatigue check).
PULSIPHER FARMS · LOGANDALE, NEVADA · CHRISTMAS TRAIN (PF-CT)
Weld and fastener schedule (AWS A2.4 symbols, torques)
Units mm unless noted · Z above top of rail · gauge 914.4 · 3rd-angle
Machined: Ra 3.2 · bores H7/H8 as noted · break edges
